extras.value: Nezha falls — a lotus blooms where he lay.
Xelhua turns to stone — his pyramid stands.

gods.name: Horus
gods.desc: Falcon strike sweeps the target's entire row, dealing 70 dmg to every enemy unit hit
gods.passive: -15% incoming damage within 2 hexes of your fortress

gods.name: Bastet
gods.desc: One of your buildings becomes immune to all damage for 8s
gods.passive: City generates food 20% faster

gods.name: Osiris
gods.desc: Temporarily revives up to 3 recently fallen warriors near your nearest building for 20s
gods.passive: Units dying within 3 hexes of your temple generate 3 favor

gods.name: Isis
gods.desc: Locks the enemy god closest to being ready, preventing its use for 15s
gods.passive: Hero units slowly regenerate health

gods.name: Ra
gods.desc: The barque sails the target's column. Strongest at noon: 40 dmg at dawn, 90 at midday, 45 at dusk
gods.passive: +15% damage while standing on open (non-forest, non-mountain) terrain

gods.name: Anubis
gods.desc: Weigh an enemy unit against Ma'at: it dies on a chance equal to the damage it has taken, never less than 20%
gods.passive: Fallen allies stay eligible for Osiris's revival for 90s (was 60s)

gods.name: Set
gods.desc: A sandstorm slows every unit (both sides) within 2 hexes of target for 6s
gods.passive: +20% damage for 5s immediately after any enemy god power is cast

gods.name: Thoth
gods.desc: Reverses target enemy unit's route, sending it marching back the way it came
gods.passive: The Scribe's Ledger: everything you buy costs 20% less — units, gods and powers alike

gods.name: Sekhmet
gods.desc: Every unit within 2 hexes of target — yours and theirs alike — attacks whatever is nearest, regardless of allegiance, for 6s
gods.passive: Enemies are weakened for 3s after engaging any of your units

gods.name: Nephthys
gods.desc: Night falls over the crossing: for 8s no unit of either army can be seen — or seen by — anything, while it stands in no-man's land
gods.passive: Losing a building grants a favor surge

gods.name: Ptah
gods.desc: The next human unit you train is created twice — his Ushabti too, but never heroes or myths
gods.passive: Buildings gain +15% max HP when Ptah unlocks

gods.name: Jade Emperor
gods.desc: Temporarily conscripts one enemy unit to fight for you for 8s, then it returns to its own side
gods.passive: While all three of your buildings stand, resource generation is boosted; losing one weakens the mandate

gods.name: Sun Wukong
gods.desc: Permanently turn one of your own units near the target into a random myth from your unlocked gods
gods.passive: Your hero units ignore all terrain movement penalties

gods.name: Nu Wa
gods.desc: Instantly repairs your most damaged building to full health
gods.passive: Human units cost 10% less food to train

gods.name: Long Wang
gods.desc: Floods a large zone into water for 8s, dealing 40 dmg to every unit caught in the deluge
gods.passive: Water tiles on your half generate extra favor; your units move faster in or adjacent to water

gods.name: Gong Gong
gods.desc: Collapses a zone into impassable rubble for 8s, blocking every route through it
gods.passive: Your units move faster in or adjacent to water

gods.name: Erlang Shen
gods.desc: The third eye sees every falsehood: reveals hidden units, unmakes the enemy's conjured ones, and returns any it has turned against you
gods.passive: He tamed the rivers: water costs your units no speed

gods.name: Xi Wangmu
gods.desc: Her garden grows over open ground near the target for 8s — bamboo your army hides in, moves through and fights from
gods.passive: Your units in bamboo move faster and deal more damage

gods.name: Zhu Rong
gods.desc: Sets a zone ablaze for 6s, dealing continuous damage to any unit standing in it
gods.passive: +25% damage against enemy units in or adjacent to water

gods.name: Chang'e
gods.desc: Slows every unit on the battlefield, both sides, for 5s, and reveals all hidden or invisible units
gods.passive: Your units move 10% faster

gods.name: Lei Gong
gods.desc: Thunder strike stuns every enemy unit within 2 hexes of target for 6s and reveals any that were hidden
gods.passive: Enemy units approaching your buildings are briefly slowed

gods.name: Huitzilopochtli
gods.desc: Buffs all your units (+30% dmg, +20% speed) for 6s, costing each 15% of its current HP
gods.passive: Killing an enemy unit generates 2 favor

gods.name: Quetzalcoatl
gods.desc: A rushing wind resets every enemy unit's route, forcing them to re-path from scratch
gods.passive: Food generation is 20% faster

gods.name: Tezcatlipoca
gods.desc: Creates a mirror image of the target enemy unit that immediately attacks the original
gods.passive: The moment Tezcatlipoca unlocks, one random enemy unit's route is reversed

gods.name: Tlaloc
gods.desc: Floods every open tile within 2 hexes of target into water for 8s
gods.passive: +20% damage while in or adjacent to a water tile

gods.name: Xipe Totec
gods.desc: Strips every passive bonus from all enemy units for 10s
gods.passive: Any building destroyed (yours or the enemy's) grants you a food surge

gods.name: Coatlicue
gods.desc: A wave of serpents poisons every enemy unit on the battlefield
gods.passive: One of your units dying generates a small amount of food

gods.name: Mictlantecuhtli
gods.desc: Grants the enemy 30 favour, then after 8s summons a RANDOM myth from your unlocked gods beside their nearest building
gods.passive: Enemy units dying anywhere generate a tiny trickle of favor for you

gods.name: Coyolxauhqui
gods.desc: Splits the target enemy unit into two weakened copies that fight each other, then expire
gods.passive: Your units deal +10% damage

gods.name: Ehecatl
gods.desc: Dramatically accelerates all your units' movement speed for 4s
gods.passive: Your units ignore all terrain movement penalties

gods.name: Itzpapalotl
gods.desc: Deals 60 dmg and a 6s slow to every enemy unit within 2 hexes of target
gods.passive: Your units deal +50% damage on their first-ever attack

gods.name: Zeus
gods.desc: A bolt strikes one enemy for 120, then arcs to the nearest other enemy within 2 hexes for 60
gods.passive: King's Authority: your units deal 15% more damage within 2 hexes of any of your buildings

gods.name: Poseidon
gods.desc: The ground splits: 90 damage to every enemy building within 3 hexes of target
gods.passive: Earthshaker: enemy buildings take 10% more damage from everything you field

gods.name: Athena
gods.desc: The aegis covers your units within 2 hexes of target: they take 50% less damage for 6s
gods.passive: Grey-Eyed: nothing can hide from you — no veil, no bamboo, no illusion

gods.name: Ares
gods.desc: Your units within 2 hexes of target deal double damage and take double damage for 6s
gods.passive: Warcry: your units deal 25% more damage to an enemy your side already outnumbers

gods.name: Apollo
gods.desc: A volley falls within 2 hexes of target: 45 damage, and those hit deal 30% less damage for 6s
gods.passive: The Lyre: your units within 3 hexes of your temple slowly heal

gods.name: Hermes
gods.desc: Picks the enemy's pocket: steals 40 favor and 40 food and gives them to you
gods.passive: The Messenger: your units finish training 25% faster

gods.name: Demeter
gods.desc: The earth withholds: the enemy generates no food at all for 8s
gods.passive: Demeter's Bounty: your City generates favor as well, at half your temple's rate

gods.name: Hades
gods.desc: Raises up to 3 recently fallen warriors — yours OR the enemy's — beside your nearest building, fighting for you for 20s
gods.passive: The Ferryman's Toll: each of your own units that dies pays you 2 favor

gods.name: Dionysus
gods.desc: Vines root every enemy unit within 2 hexes of target for 4s — they can still fight, but they cannot move
gods.passive: Resurrection: each of your myth units rises once after death at 40% health

gods.name: Artemis
gods.desc: Actaeon's End: marks the nearest enemy as quarry for 8s — its own side turns and hunts it, it cannot hide from you, and your units in reach join the kill
gods.passive: The Silver Bow: your ranged units deal 10% more damage

gods.name: Hephaestus
gods.desc: Stokes the forge: the next 3 units you train are created with 40% more health
gods.passive: Automata: your siege units deal 25% more damage to buildings
